description: This Java source file defines the HomeListenerService class, which extends WearableListenerService to handle DataItem events from a wearable device. It manages notifications related to calendar data items, including creating, updating, and deleting notifications with associated assets like profile pictures.

classes.name: HomeListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for DataItem events from a wearable device and manages notifications for calendar events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects it.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming DataEventBuffer, processing deletions and updates.

methods.name: deleteDataItem
methods.description: Removes notifications associated with a deleted DataItem.

methods.name: updateNotificationForDataItem
methods.description: Creates or updates a notification based on the DataItem's data, including setting profile pictures and event details.
